name: oracle-shift-bench
description:
Oracle Shift Bench
	

A synthetic multivariate time-series benchmark dataset for distribution shift and corruption robustness evaluation.

	
		
		Motivation
	

Real-world time-series data often exhibits distribution shifts and various forms of corruption (missing data, lag, noise, regime changes). This benchmark provides a controlled environment to evaluate model robustness to these common failure modes.
